description: The recurring COD picture, 1600x560: item line y 170 (x 240-1360, arrowhead right) and money line y 390 (arrowhead left), thin 3 px ink; four numbered round step markers (white disc, ink rim, red numeral, dia 84) #step-1 (300,170) booking, #step-2 (800,170) carriage, #step-3 (1300,280) collection, #step-4 (800,390) remittance, each a group so a scene can colour it yellow #f2b705; clear zones at both ends for person icons. Parts #line-item, #line-money, #arrow-item, #arrow-money, #step-1..#step-4. No lettering.
Flat parcel box 220x180, kraft #f3ead6 fill, 3 px ink outline, ink string crossed over it, small blank white label on the front.

Big front face of a parcel 960x600, kraft #f3ead6, ink outline, ink string crossing centre-right; three blank white zones: #zone-cod upper left (x40-420, y40-210), #zone-sender lower left (x40-420, y400-560), #zone-address right (x520-920, y280-520) with three grey rule lines. No lettering.

White money order form 600x400, ink outline, dashed perforation at y 250 splitting #upper (blank grey rules, blank field box #field-place x40-300 y150-210) from #lower (coupon with two rules). No lettering.
Thin grey #6f6a63 4 px line x30-1590 at y 120 with 15 small ticks #tick-1..#tick-15 at x = 60 + (n-1)*107; empty space above for bands and markers, below for the scene's day numerals. 1620x220.
Large white address label 380x240 with three blank rule lines, a reinforced hole at the left end and an ink string loop.

Five flat ink icons in a row on 300 px centres, 1500x240, each its own group: #book (open bound book), #portal (browser window), #social (speech bubbles), #phone (handset), #letter (envelope with pen). No lettering.
Flat identity card 260x170, white with ink outline, grey photo square holding a plain sand silhouette (no face), blank lines.
Flat ink wrist watch 220x300, white dial with two hands, sand strap.
